description: Behavioral window feature schema for Random Forest activity classification

features.name: event_count
features.description: Total number of file system events in the observation window

features.name: unique_files
features.description: Number of distinct file paths observed in the window

features.name: decoy_events
features.description: Total number of events directly involving recognized decoy files

features.name: decoy_ratio
features.description: Proportion of decoy events relative to total events (0.0 for empty windows)

features.name: create_count
features.description: Count of CREATE events in the window

features.name: modify_count
features.description: Count of MODIFY events in the window

features.name: delete_count
features.description: Count of DELETE events in the window

features.name: rename_count
features.description: Count of RENAME events (both old and new designations) in the window

features.name: events_per_second
features.description: Event arrival rate: event_count divided by window duration in seconds

features.name: inter_event_mean
features.description: Mean time interval in seconds between consecutive events (0.0 if fewer than 2 events)

features.name: inter_event_std
features.description: Standard deviation of inter-event time intervals in seconds (0.0 if fewer than 2 events)

target.name: is_suspicious
target.description: Binary label: 0 = Normal activity, 1 = Suspicious activity
